Your trust means everything to us.

🌐 Official Website
📸 Official Instagram Page
👍 Official Facebook Page
💬 Official WhatsApp Channel

Our official logo is displayed consistently across all these platforms to help you identify our genuine accounts.

We have noticed that some social media pages are reposting our job posters and carousel posts, including content containing our watermark. While public content may be shared by others, such pages are not affiliated with or managed by Daily Jobs Goa unless they are one of our official platforms.

⚠️ Please verify job updates only through our official channels. Be cautious before sharing personal information, making payments, or responding to messages from unofficial accounts.

A walk-in interview opportunity at Shree Damodar Higher Secondary School of Science, Comba, Margao!

The institution is inviting applications for two positions:

🔹 Laboratory Attendant (MTS) – 1 Post\
Qualification: SSCE (Class X)\
Employment Basis: Contract

🔹 Teacher in Physics – 1 Post\
Qualification: M.Sc. in Physics with B.Ed.\
Employment Basis: Contract (Child Care Leave vacancy)

📅 Interview Date: 10th November 2026\
⏰ Time: 9:00 AM\
📍 Venue: Shree Damodar Higher Secondary School of Science, Comba, Margao, Goa

Important: Candidates must attend the interview with an application and all relevant educational certificates, marksheets and supporting documents.

Interested and eligible candidates are encouraged to attend the walk-in interview.

🌱 A career opportunity rooted in agriculture!

Goa College of Agriculture, Ela Farm, Old Goa, invites applications for the position of Lab – Field Assistant on a contractual basis for 11 months.

💼 Monthly Remuneration: ₹20,000 (Consolidated)\
🎓 Qualification: B.Sc. in Agriculture\
🔬 Preferred Experience: Work related to biofertilizers and biopesticides production and utilisation.

📌 How to Apply?\
Eligible candidates must submit their applications along with self-attested/certified copies of mark sheets from SSC onwards.

📍 Applications should reach the Principal, Goa College of Agriculture, Ela Farm, Old Goa, within 8 days from the date of advertisement (30 October 2026).

📝 Application format is available on the official website of Goa College of Agriculture.

For those passionate about agriculture, this could be an opportunity to turn knowledge into practical experience.
